We have a Requirement UI Developer with JavaScript position in Cupertino, CA. If you have any matching resumes for the below mentioned position.

 

Please share the suitable resource for this Position.

Please share the Visa Copy and Photo ID Proof of your consultants

 

VERY URGENT AND IMMEDIATE NEED

 

Job Title: UI Developer with JavaScript

Location: Cupertino, CA (Local)

Duration: Long Term Contract

 

Rate: $45/hr on All Inc,

Interview mode: Need to attend F2F

 

Job Description

Must Have Experience:

1.         Solid knowledge in HTML/CSS/JavaScript

2.         Experience in ReactJS/Redux or similar MVC frameworks is expected

3.         Experience working with Sass/Scss or similar preprocessor is expected

4.         Experience writing unit tests in JavaScript (karma, mocha, chai, sinon, enzyme etc.) is expected

5.         Understanding of HTML semantics and CSS cascading/specificity is expected

6.         Experience working with source controlled code base like git or svn is expected

 

Nice to have exposure/knowledge

1.         Experience working with JSP/Spring based application is a plus

2.         Experience working with Java/PHP/Ruby or similar language is a plus

3.         Experience working in Agile Scrum team is a plus

4.         Experience working with Accessibility (Keyboard/VoiceOver) is a big plus

5.         Experience working with tools like Node/Npm, Bower, Gulp, Grunt, Browserify is a plus
